evidence_policy: A nearby passing source test is supporting evidence, never proof of the full GDD T scenario. Tests T-01 through T-16 remain incomplete pending explicit exact-scenario execution.

cases.scenario: Deliver one finite item, restart mid-handoff
cases.canonical_invariant: Exactly one custodian and one valid ledger sequence
cases.open_gap: Missing forced real process restart precisely between custody transfer and ledger commit.

cases.canonical_invariant: One succeeds and the other receives truthful shortage
cases.open_gap: Missing simultaneous independent clients contending for the final identical stock unit.

cases.canonical_invariant: No reopened broken lamp or duplicate fitting
cases.open_gap: Post-restart physical state and pre-restart duplicate attempt exist; explicit retry after process restart remains untraced.

cases.scenario: Merchant market hold across offline clock
cases.canonical_invariant: Timed resolution is honest and cannot deadlock all professions
cases.open_gap: Pure day transition is covered; missing real offline clock passage with client reconnect/other-role progress.

cases.canonical_invariant: Claim preserved without altering physical objective truth

source_evidence.symbol: truth status must remain deliberately unset after restart

cases.open_gap: Missing targeted negative publisher action proving unsupported allegation never changes the actual object.

cases.canonical_invariant: No direct witnessed memory absent real plausible dissemination
cases.open_gap: Attendance/hour guards exist; missing explicit late-arrival independent client and post-restart social-memory check.

cases.scenario: Hound and Wanderer inspect same route
cases.canonical_invariant: Different analysis of one physical route, no competing worlds
cases.open_gap: Current shared report does not establish distinctive passability versus threat/protection decisions.
Existing treatment/assessment test is not patient privacy or consent; needs real patient-record permission case.

cases.canonical_invariant: Valid alternate relief or drive cannot ship
cases.open_gap: Food stock guards do not establish that every live bodily need has valid alternative relief when exhausted.

cases.scenario: Human versus AI client same action
cases.canonical_invariant: Equal role permission, matter, time and privacy outcome
cases.open_gap: AI client test uses fake transport; explicit independent human/AI same-state action parity matrix not evidenced.

cases.scenario: Rare inscription seen by two, missed by third
cases.canonical_invariant: First two see same objective fact, third no firsthand claim
cases.open_gap: Signed studies and firsthand viewing exercised; missing explicitly coordinated 3-account witness/nonwitness test.

cases.scenario: Scheduled incident with no active players
cases.canonical_invariant: Bounded NPC or expiry result, never forged player contribution
cases.open_gap: Day renewal is not proof of a no-players scheduled event reaching its canonical NPC/expiry outcome.

cases.scenario: Two accounts cancel versus complete same order
cases.canonical_invariant: Exactly one terminal result, reconciled supplies
cases.open_gap: Duplicate delivery guards exist; no documented competing cancellation/completion terminal transaction.

cases.canonical_invariant: Both sides revoke, professional biography retained

source_evidence.symbol: Respecialization did not erase the earlier Chronicler record.

cases.open_gap: Profession respecialization is not a bilateral apprenticeship withdrawal; requires explicit two-account relationship test.

cases.canonical_invariant: Revision audit, recipient awareness and claim/source separation preserved

source_evidence.symbol: Harbinger The Correction must survive restart as an archive discrepancy.

cases.open_gap: Archive and discrepancy persist; missing explicit after-correction resident recipient knowledge/awareness differentiation.

cases.canonical_invariant: Pending, resumed, expired, completed-by-others truthfully exposed
cases.open_gap: Agenda and expiry each work separately; missing integrated genuine interrupted multi-step responsibility and reentry narrative.
